prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A3.2 prescribed display paths with equal radii, one common frequency, 120-degree phase spacing, and independently selected axial/transverse decompositions.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0 selects the mutually orthogonal near-rest endpoint, with binary orbit planes yz, xz, and xy in the declared relative frame.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; positive h_a values separate the endpoint orbit centers while retaining one common radius R=0.32.
The common frequency f=0.25 and phases 0, 2pi/3, and 4pi/3 instantiate A3.2.
Normalized linear axis interpolation defines the wider taxonomy path but does not alter this near-rest representative.
